newsitem.title: HUNGARY: BSE suspends Goldsun trade for day.
newsitem.headline: BSE suspends Goldsun trade for day.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) suspended trading in frozen food manufacturer Goldsun Hutoipari Rt for the day, the BSE said on Monday.

The BSE said an article in the daily Vilaggazdasag about U.S.-based Shamrock Capital Investors writing off its investment in Goldsun and the other major owner, Sunfrost Ltd, considering the same step could have influenced trading.
"The article contained information that could substantially influence the share price, but the issuer could not confirm the information until trading has started," the BSE said in a statement.
Shamrock and Sunfrost each have a 35.9 percent stake in Goldsun, and the remaining 28.2 percent is owned by small shareholders.
Goldsun shares closed at 220 forints on Friday, down from a year high of 550 forints.
